validity.recommendation: Existence and classification confirmed independently; no duplicate found. See status_reviews for a material Status staleness finding (proposed vs. likely construction) and note below on unverifiable primary source.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: this row is NOT a GEM-only entity. The sheet's own cited value ref (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn/.../t2198137.shtml, a Guangxi Development & Reform Commission project-approval notice) could not be loaded directly in this environment -- every Guangxi/China .gov.cn domain tested (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn, dnr.gxzf.gov.cn, guilin.gov.cn, nynct.gxzf.gov.cn) returned ConnectTimeout/ECONNREFUSED both via url_verifier and WebFetch, and gx.chinanews.com failed DNS resolution -- this looks like a network-level block on this sandbox rather than evidence the sources don't exist (Wayback Machine has no snapshot of the specific approval page either, only of the fgw.gxzf.gov.cn homepage). The sheet's Fuel/PipelineType ref (news.bjx.com.cn/html/20210326/1144324-4.shtml) returns HTTP 200 but is actually an Alibaba-Cloud WAF bot-challenge page with no real article text (confirmed by raw curl + r.jina.ai render, both showing only a 'slide to verify' captcha shell) -- this explains why url_verifier's ProposalYear check ('data value not found') came back negative: the page never delivered real content to any automated fetch, not that the article omits the pipeline. Despite all of that, an independent Chinese-language search (Sogou, since the WebSearch tool's session budget was already exhausted) surfaced the project under its full official name '桂东北天然气环网桂林—阳朔—荔浦段' (Northeast-Guilin gas ring network, Guilin-Yangshuo-Lipu section) in at least five mutually independent, non-GEM sources spanning 2021-2025: (1) Guangxi Daily (广西日报) epaper, 2021-11-15, an EIA public-comment notice for this exact project naming the project company as China National Pipeline Group (PipeChina) Southwest Oil & Gas Pipeline Co., Nanning Branch -- URL VERIFIED live (see proposed_refs); (2) Guangxi NDRC (广西发改委) project-approval reply dated 2022-06-10, reported by Bjx power-industry news 2022-06-16 ('同意建设' = approved for construction) -- underlying gov.cn doc and the specific bjx URL both unreachable/WAF-blocked from this session; (3) China News Guangxi (中新网 gx.chinanews.com), 2023-12-27, reporting the Lipu section (荔浦段) had reached 90% of construction workload -- DNS-blocked from this session; (4-5) Guangxi provincial government land-conversion approvals for the Yangshuo/Lipu section (published 2024-01-15 and 2024-04-18) and the Lingui section (2023-04-18, still referenced as recently as 2025-02-21 by the Guangxi Agriculture & Rural Affairs Dept) -- all on dnr.gxzf.gov.cn / nynct.gxzf.gov.cn, unreachable from this session. All five snippets independently name the same project, same three place names (Guilin/Yangshuo/Lipu), consistent with GEM's StartPrefecture=Guilin / EndLocation=Lipu. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a gas transmission branch/segment of the wider Guangxi network, not a gathering/process line -- no issue. DUPLICATE: checked against all 42 other Guangxi rows in the roster; no other row shares this Guilin-Yangshuo-Lipu routing (the other 'Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network' rows are named for different towns/counties: Bobai, Binyang, Xingbin, Fusui, etc.) -- not a duplicate/relabel. SPEC: length (100km), diameter (273.1mm), capacity (0.17 bcm/y), pressure (4 MPa) and cost (RMB 346.04m, 2019) all trace to the single unreachable fgw.gxzf.gov.cn approval doc; I could not independently corroborate the numeric values this session given the network block, so I am not flagging them wrong, only unconfirmed -- recommend a re-check from an unrestricted network. RECOMMENDATION: do not treat existence as in doubt; the real open issue is the Status value going stale (see status_reviews).

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The sheet's Status was last touched 2025-08-25 and still reads 'proposed', but independent Chinese-language reporting shows the project moved well past the proposal stage years earlier: EIA public comment ran Nov 2021 (Guangxi Daily, URL verified live and quoted above -- names the project company as PipeChina Southwest Oil & Gas Pipeline Co., Nanning Branch); Guangxi NDRC issued a formal project-approval reply on 2022-06-10 ('同意建设', agreeing to construction), reported by Bjx industry news 2022-06-16; and China News Guangxi reported on 2023-12-27 that the project's Lipu section (荔浦段) had already reached 90% of construction workload. Provincial land-conversion approvals for the Yangshuo and Lipu sections followed in Jan/Apr 2024, and a Guangxi Agriculture & Rural Affairs Dept item from 2025-02-21 still references the project's Lingui-section land approval in the context of ongoing 2025 infrastructure build-out -- i.e. some sub-segments may still be finishing land formalities even after others were substantially built. Net picture: as of the most concrete dated evidence I could find (Dec 2023, 90% complete on the Lipu leg), this pipeline was firmly in CONSTRUCTION, not merely proposed -- and given ~2.5 years have passed since that data point with no dormancy, it may plausibly be operating by now, but I found no direct 'gas flow started' / '通气' or '投产' confirmation this session to justify going that far. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: only ONE of the five corroborating sources (the 2021 Guangxi Daily EIA notice) could be fetched and url_verifier-passed from this sandboxed environment -- the NDRC-approval bjx.com.cn article is served from behind an Alibaba-Cloud WAF bot-challenge that returns HTTP 200 with no real content to any automated fetch (confirmed via raw curl and r.jina.ai render), and every dnr.gxzf.gov.cn/fgw.gxzf.gov.cn/gx.chinanews.com/nynct.gxzf.gov.cn URL either timed out, refused the connection, or failed DNS resolution outright -- all consistent with a network-level block on Chinese government/news domains from this session rather than the sources not existing (Wayback Machine also has no cached snapshot of the specific pages, only of unrelated homepages). I'm staging 'construction' as the proposed change because the 2021 EIA-notice source alone establishes the project was real and in active permitting in 2021 (consistent with GEM's own ProposalYear=2021), and the weight of the additional independent snippets (NDRC approval 2022, 90%-built 2023, land approvals 2023-24) all point the same direction with no conflicting evidence found -- but this change should be treated as needing one more independently-fetched confirming URL before being applied, ideally from an unrestricted network, given only one of the five corroborating sources actually passed verification here. I did not set a ConstructionYear because I have no confirmed 'construction commenced in X' date -- only that it was 90% done by Dec 2023 and formally approved mid-2022; a researcher with working access to bjx.com.cn / gx.chinanews.com / dnr.gxzf.gov.cn should be able to pin an exact ConstructionYear and check whether it has since gone operating.

summary: P7662 (Guilin-Yangshuo-Lipu Branch) is real -- independently confirmed via a verified 2021 Guangxi Daily EIA notice plus several unreachable-from-this-session-but-independently-indexed government/news sources (NDRC approval 2022, 90%-complete-by-Dec-2023 report, 2023-24 land approvals) -- correctly classified, and not a duplicate of any other Guangxi row; the sheet's Status='proposed' (as of 2025-08-25) looks stale and is flagged for a change to 'construction', though only one of the five corroborating sources could be url_verifier-passed from this network-restricted session, so treat as UNRESOLVED pending a second independently-fetched confirming URL before applying.
